instructions.Plastic: Rinse containers, remove caps, flatten bottles. Remove labels if possible.
instructions.Metal: Rinse cans, remove labels. Flatten aluminum cans. Separate ferrous and non-ferrous.
instructions.Glass: Rinse thoroughly. Separate by color (clear, green, brown). Remove lids and caps.
instructions.Paper: Keep dry and clean. Flatten cardboard boxes. Remove plastic windows from envelopes.
instructions.Rubber: Separate tires from rims. Clean rubber items. Remove non-rubber parts.
instructions.Organic: Compostable waste only. Remove packaging. Cut large pieces for faster decomposition.
instructions.E-waste: Remove batteries separately. Do not break screens. Bring to designated e-waste points.
instructions.Textile: Wash and dry items. Separate wearable from non-wearable. Bundle with string.
instructions.Mixed: Needs manual sorting. Separate different material types before recycling.
instructions.Unknown: Cannot identify material. Please bring to an EcoPoint for manual assessment.

ai.subtitle: The intelligence layer behind recycling, community action and measurable impact.
ai.disclaimer: ZAMINAT AI Core is designed to become the intelligence layer of our Waste-to-Life ecosystem — helping identify recyclable materials, guide citizens, verify reports, calculate impact and support future production planning.
ai.pitchSubtitle: 2 AI modules are live in production (AI EcoScan + ZAMI AI Advisor). ZAMINAT AI Core turns environmental activity into verified data, measurable impact and scalable infrastructure planning — powered by Google Gemini 3.1.
ai.roadmapSubtitle: Staged rollout to scale operations, secure data, and drive ecological value.

ecoscan.title: AI EcoScan
ecoscan.desc: Ready-to-use computer vision system that instantly identifies plastic, rubber and other recyclables from photos. Classifies waste type, estimates volume, and maps nearest collection routes with live Eco Coin rewards.

ecocoach.title: ZAMI AI Advisor
ecocoach.desc: An advanced multilingual AI assistant that guides citizens in Uzbek, Russian, and English. Fully ready to use and integrated with AI EcoScan: answers recycling queries, recommends collection points, and provides customized ecological tips.

impact.title: AI Impact Engine
impact.desc: Calculates waste collected, products created and real community impact in real time. Converts recycling data into tangible outputs — eco-tiles produced, CO₂ saved, park benches funded — so every action has measurable results.

fraud.title: AI Anti-Fraud
fraud.desc: Verifies reports using GPS validation, photo integrity checks, timestamp analysis and anomaly detection. Ensures every recycling submission is legitimate and protects the ecosystem from duplicate or fraudulent claims.

kids.title: AI EcoKids Tutor
kids.desc: Personalizes ecological education for children through gamified sorting challenges, interactive quizzes and achievement badges. Makes learning about recycling fun while building sustainable habits from an early age.

planner.title: AI Production Planner
planner.desc: Connects collected materials with future product output by forecasting feedstock availability, optimizing batch schedules and recommending production priorities. Bridges citizen recycling data with factory operations.

citizen.title: Citizen Layer
citizen.desc: Enables user-friendly waste recognition and guidance.

trust.title: Trust Layer
trust.desc: Secures data integrity and prevents gamification exploitation.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure Layer
infrastructure.desc: Bridges local data with factory scales and community infrastructure.
